author: China Insights
description:
In Xiangyang, Hubei, more than 20 mental hospitals have popped up everywhere like beef noodle shops. Getting out is as hard as getting out of prison. Medical insurance money is being stolen like crazy! The reporter who went undercover in mental hospitals is the same person who exposed the oil tankers carrying edible oil.
【The Chinese Communist Party governs a big country like baking big pancakes. Opening mental hospitals is like opening beef noodle shops.】
China Insights delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of China’s politics, economy, and society.

title: Getting out is as hard as getting out of prison. Medical insurance money is being stolen like crazy!
